# uplot

A small, fast canvas chart library: the widget for the host-metrics
page. Vendored as the browser IIFE build plus its stylesheet.

- Source: https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot
- Vendored: npm `uplot@1.6.32` dist files (via jsdelivr)
- License: MIT - the full text is in `LICENSE`
- Files: `uPlot.iife.min.js`, `uPlot.min.css`
- Used by: `examples/hello_server` (embedded gzip assets, served at
  `/uplot.iife.min.js` and `/uplot.min.css`)
